summary: Iteration 32 (P01 selector + real Cloudflare Turnstile + universal /advertiser access) tested end-to-end against the preview URL. Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_iter32_turnstile.py = 9/9 PASS (Turnstile enforced on /auth/login and /auth/register, advertiser + referral-partner self-registration, brute-force 429 lockout, httpOnly cookie, bcrypt $2b$ hash). Frontend (Playwright via browser tool): P01 selector renders with all 7 option testids, CTA gating works (disabled + hint -> enabled), popup opens on the correct tab, the REAL Cloudflare Turnstile widget renders and its completion flips submit buttons from disabled to enabled on BOTH tabs, guest login and guest registration both land on /advertiser with the workspace rendered, staff (admin@trel.com.pg) sees the P01 selector with NO category-mismatch notice and p01-proceed-authed reaches /advertiser, legacy /admin/login and /register redirect to the popup, X + Escape dismiss keeps selections, password-mismatch guard blocks the register call. Local e2e specs: h01-authoritative 2/2 PASS, popup-authoritative 9/9 PASS (--workers=1, no flake seen). THREE real defects found: (1) legacy /admin/login?next=%2Fadmin logs the admin into /advertiser instead of /admin because AddProperty hardcodes next="/advertiser" and ignores the next query param; (2) GET /api/properties?status= returns ALL properties (incl. withdrawn/draft) to anonymous callers, and the AdvertiserWorkspace now shows every other advertiser's listings with Edit/Delete controls (no ownership scoping in routes/properties.py) - materially worse now that /advertiser is open to any authenticated user; (3) Turnstile enforcement broke the whole legacy backend regression suite (184 collection errors) - mitigated by a test-only conftest patch I added, remaining 27 failures are mostly pre-existing schema drift plus a genuine CORS regression (wildcard origin with allow-credentials).

critical.issue: No authorization/ownership scoping: anonymous and non-owner advertiser callers receive ALL properties including withdrawn/draft records. routes/properties.py list/update/delete only require 'property writer' role, never owner match, so any advertiser can edit/delete another advertiser's listing. Exposure amplified because /advertiser is now reachable by every authenticated user.

Turnstile enforcement rejects every existing non-browser client with 400 'Human verification failed'. The whole legacy pytest suite failed at setup (184 errors) until a token was injected. Any script/integration calling /auth/login now breaks - consider a server-to-server bypass (API key / service token) or documenting the requirement.

Response is 'access-control-allow-origin: *' while cookies are set with credentials; browsers reject credentialed requests against a wildcard origin. Pre-existing test test_iter28_screen_matrix.py::TestAuthHardening::test_cors_allows_credentials_with_explicit_origin now FAILS. CORS_ORIGINS="*" in backend/.env overrides TREL_ALLOWED_ORIGINS.

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 200 with {'status':'ok','message':'Backend API is running. Frontend build folder not found in container.'} instead of 404 - the SPA catch-all swallows unknown API routes and can mask client bugs.

With Cloudflare's ALWAYS-PASSING test secret, /siteverify returns success for ANY non-empty token (verified: the always-FAILING test token 2x0000... returns 200 login). Only the empty/missing-token path can be exercised locally - the real reject path is untestable until a production secret is set. Also core/db.py falls back to DB_NAME='trel_db' when the env var is absent, silently writing to the wrong database (my first cleanup script hit the empty trel_db).

27 pre-existing failures remain after the conftest fix: test_iter24_lock_and_legal + test_map_coords + test_iter27 property payloads are stale vs the current schema ('Province is required', 'Select an active Property Type'); test_lead_convert/test_locations/test_p3_integrated_property error at import (KeyError REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL / JWT_SECRET - no dotenv load); test_iter28 'created property appears in list' fails.

ui_bugs.issue: Legacy /admin/login redirects to /add-property?auth=login&next=%2Fadmin but AddProperty passes next="/advertiser" hardcoded, so a STAFF/admin login through the popup lands on the Property Advertiser Workspace instead of /admin. Read the `next` search param and pass it through (fall back to /advertiser).

It embeds the ADMIN Properties component (api.get('/properties', {status:''})), so a brand-new advertiser immediately sees 10 unrelated HARDENING_TEST/TEST_ITER29 listings with Edit and Delete icons. Needs an owner-scoped listing for non-staff users.

issues: Header is unbranded relative to the public site (tiny letter-spaced 'TRELPNG' label, no logo/nav), so the login->/advertiser transition looks like a different product
'Sign out' is a bare text link with no button affordance
Withdrawn-status listings dominate the first screen with no filter/empty-state for a new advertiser
Turnstile always-pass widget shows the red 'For testing only. If seen, report to site owner' strip - fine for preview, must not reach production keys

action_items: Pass the `next` query param from /add-property through to AccountAccessDialog so /admin/login sends staff to /admin (currently everyone lands on /advertiser).

Scope property listing/update/delete by owner: GET /api/properties?status= currently leaks all draft/withdrawn listings to anonymous callers, and any advertiser can edit/delete another advertiser's property.
Give AdvertiserWorkspace an owner-scoped properties view instead of reusing the admin Properties component.

Fix CORS: stop returning 'access-control-allow-origin: *' when credentials are allowed (use TREL_ALLOWED_ORIGINS explicitly); test_iter28 TestAuthHardening::test_cors_allows_credentials_with_explicit_origin is failing.
Decide on a non-browser path for /auth/login (service token or documented Turnstile requirement) - Turnstile broke every existing script/test client.
Return 404 for unknown /api/* paths instead of the SPA fallback 200 payload.

Refresh the stale legacy tests (test_iter24_lock_and_legal, test_map_coords, test_iter27 property payloads) and add dotenv loading to test_lead_convert/test_locations/test_p3_integrated_property, which error at import.
critical_code_review_comments: AddProperty.jsx line 160: `next="/advertiser"` is hardcoded, discarding the `next` search param produced by App.js's legacy redirect - this silently reroutes staff logins.

routes/properties.py: list_properties/update_property/delete_property have no ownership predicate; require_property_writer is a role check only. Add owner_user_id filtering for non-staff and reject status='' (all statuses) for unauthenticated callers.
core/db.py: `DB_NAME = os.getenv("DB_NAME", "trel_db")` - drop the default so a missing env var fails fast instead of writing to a phantom database.

core/turnstile.py: verify_turnstile() returns True when TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY is unset - a config mistake in production silently disables the challenge. Prefer failing closed outside an explicit DEV flag.

AccountAccessDialog.jsx: the Turnstile effect depends on the inline `onToken` callback (`handleTurnstile` is re-created every render); it survives today only because setState is stable in the parent, but a memoized useCallback would remove the re-render/re-render widget risk (likely the source of the reported parallel-run widget race).
backend/.env has CORS_ORIGINS="*" alongside an explicit TREL_ALLOWED_ORIGINS - remove the wildcard.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/conftest.py (new - session autouse patch injecting the always-passing Turnstile test token into /auth/login and /auth/register bodies so the legacy suite runs; opt out by passing turnstile_token explicitly). This reduced the suite from 184 setup errors to 0 auth-related errors (243 passed / 27 failed / 9 errors).

success_rate.backend: 100% on the iteration-32 suite (9/9); 90% on the full regression suite (243/270 after the conftest fix)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 15 requested P01/popup/Turnstile assertions passed; 2 HIGH routing/authorization defects found outside the happy paths

context_for_next_testing_agent: Turnstile is enforced: every /api/auth/login or /api/auth/register call MUST include turnstile_token. /app/backend/tests/conftest.py now auto-injects '1x0000000000000000000000000000AA' for those two endpoints unless you pass the key explicitly (pass turnstile_token=None to test the 400 path). pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope; use '-n 0' for serial (NOT -p no:xdist). Note the always-pass secret makes ANY non-empty token succeed, so the reject path cannot be validated beyond missing/empty tokens. Frontend e2e: /app/backend/frontend/e2e/popup-authoritative.spec.js 9/9 and h01-authoritative.spec.js 2/2 pass with --workers=1. Still open and unverified after fixes: next-param routing for /admin/login, owner scoping of /api/properties, CORS wildcard, 404 for unknown /api paths.
rca_of_the_issue: 1) Staff mis-routing: App.js redirects /admin/login -> /add-property?auth=login&next=%2Fadmin, but AddProperty renders <AccountAccessDialog next="/advertiser"> unconditionally; destinationFor() returns `next` first, so the account_category/workspace_path logic is never consulted and admins land on /advertiser. 2) Property leakage: the advertiser workspace reuses admin Properties, which calls GET /properties with status='' ; routes/properties.py build_property_query applies no owner or visibility filter and the endpoint has no auth dependency, so all statuses are public. 3) Regression-suite breakage: verify_turnstile() rejects a missing token with 400 before any auth logic, and every legacy test logged in without one; patched at the test layer via tests/conftest.py rather than by weakening the product behaviour.
